name: userscript-maker
description: Compile TypeScript userscripts (defineMeta + code) into standard .user.js files: lint, dev harness, catalog and release packing with Bun

scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run fmt:check && bun run typecheck && bun test
scripts.build:fixtures: bun src/cli.ts build test/fixtures/demo test/fixtures/hn-cleaner test/fixtures/copy-code test/fixtures/sticky-table-head test/fixtures/github-stars --external lodash=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lodash@4.17.21/lodash.min.js#_
scripts.check:fixtures: bun src/cli.ts check test/fixtures/demo test/fixtures/hn-cleaner test/fixtures/copy-code test/fixtures/sticky-table-head test/fixtures/github-stars --external lodash=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lodash@4.17.21/lodash.min.js#_ --strict
scripts.dev:fixtures: bun src/cli.ts dev test/fixtures/demo test/fixtures/hn-cleaner test/fixtures/copy-code test/fixtures/sticky-table-head test/fixtures/github-stars --external lodash=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lodash@4.17.21/lodash.min.js#_
